title: NULL semantics
summary: NULL means unknown or missing, so ordinary equality and Boolean reasoning need special handling.

blocks.text: NULL means unknown or missing, so ordinary equality and Boolean reasoning need special handling.

items: Use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, not = NULL.
COALESCE chooses the first non-NULL expression.
Comparisons with NULL yield UNKNOWN, which WHERE does not keep.
Be careful with NOT IN when the subquery can contain NULL; NOT EXISTS is often safer.
